procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 (cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/covington/; this county's rotation is opposite Chickasaw's/Carroll's). Doubtful cells resolved at 800 dpi (two fax-digit misreads fixed by the printed-TOTAL arithmetic: Lee's Williamsburg cell prints 187, Martin's Seminary/West Collins cell prints 988). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (12/12).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets: p1 is the certification/signature page (signed Nov 14); p2+p3 = table A over the county's 15 precincts (11 columns, then South Collins/Station Creek/Strahan/Williamsburg + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections (ending at Chancery 2 Place 3's row); p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying Circuit 13's two Places and the local sections. The section boundary fell cleanly (no carry row). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 03-3rd Congressional District; Court Of Appeals 04-District 4 Position 2 (David McCarty -- the same section Adams and Copiah print, roster identical); Chancery Court 2-Chancery District 2 Place 1 (Roy Noble Lee Jr.), Place 2 (Gerald M. Martin), Place 3 (David Shoemake) -- the same Chancery 2 roster Jasper prints, names identical; Circuit Court 13-Circuit District 13 Place 1 (Matthew G. Sullivan) and Place 2 (Stanley Sorey) -- the same Circuit 13 roster Jasper prints, names identical. Printed totals: Colom 2913, Hyde-Smith 3766, Pinkins 220, Chiaradio 2762, Guest 4033, Klehle 92, McCarty 5736, Roy Noble Lee Jr. 5719, Martin 5716, Shoemake 5942, Sullivan 5805, Sorey 5487.
operator_rows_note: All 12 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (four precinct cells + printed TOTAL); Sullivan's and Sorey's rows carry p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row. Digit checks: Roy Noble Lee Jr.'s Williamsburg cell was first read 167 at 220 dpi -- the 800 dpi zoom prints 187 (5/6-adjacent fax digits), which makes the row's cell sum equal its printed TOTAL; Gerald M. Martin's Seminary/West Collins cell similarly prints 988, not 986.
truncation_note: No truncations; the fifteen precinct headers print complete (Collins, Dry Creek, 'Gilmer / Yawn', 'Lone Star / Black Jack', Mitchell, Mt Olive, Okahay, Richmond, Rock Hill, Sanford, 'Seminary/West Collins', South Collins, Station Creek, Strahan, Williamsburg).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 13 Place 2: School Board 5-School Board Member District 5 (Charles Fairley) and Supervisor District 2-Supervisor District 2 (eight Independents: Philip Anderson, Robert Aultman, Gary G. Deen, Shawn Duckworth, Linwood Evenson, Marion Elizey, Dean Estes, Gavin Herring) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages.
